title: THE FORGE: THE UPGRADE MODEL
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: a pack-a-punch to upgrade guns and add elemental damage, in raid only, and you keep an upgraded gun you extract with. This build is the model only, so nothing in play changes yet. A MK II gun does about 30 percent more damage a round, holds a quarter more rounds and reloads a fifth faster; a MK III gun adds one of four elements (FIRE, SHOCK, CRYO, ACID). Fire rate, spread, range and noise never change. Upgrading twice never stacks, and a found gun keeps its rolled quality. A forged gun ranks one or two steps higher, so the gun card and the DEMO gun routing never call a MK III rifle a downgrade against a plain Support MG.
now: The upgrade model for the Forge is in, ready for the station.
